body: Deep-dive-generated forward test (NOT a recommendation; not buy/sell). Live deep dive #4, company drawn at random from pharma/healthcare + IT services names in the Rs 1,000-20,000 cr band (method test, L9/L21). Probability 0.55 (naive base rate 0.23) that: Indraprastha Medical FY27 operating profit (revenue - materials - employee - other expenses, ex other income) / revenue from operations is >= 18.0%. Our reasoning: H1 FY27 OPM 19.2% (Q1 19.7%, Q2 18.6%); H2 is seasonally weaker (H2 FY26 16.7%); central estimate ~18.1%. Naive base: 2 of 11 fiscal years FY16-FY26 had OPM >= 18.0% (FY25 18.07%, FY26 18.005%); Laplace (2+1)/(11+2) = 0.23 [SCR, AR26]. Resolution: YES if FY27 OPM (resolver definition: operating profit ex other income / revenue from operations, standalone) >= 18.0% (rounded to 1 dp). Source: NSE integrated-filing XBRL / screener annual. Resolve by 2027-05-31; score with Brier vs the base rate.
